description: This file defines authentication-related API endpoints for user registration, login, profile management, password reset, and Azure AD sign-in integration, using Express.js and various security and database utilities.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Handles user registration, hashing passwords, creating user records, and handling optional profile fields.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, verifies account status, and issues JWT tokens.

methods.name: PATCH /auth/profile
methods.description: Updates current user's profile information such as name and professional title.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's profile.

methods.name: POST /auth/azure/find-or-create
methods.description: Finds or creates a user based on Azure AD sign-in data, managing roles and tokens accordingly.

methods.name: POST /auth/forgot-password
methods.description: Generates a password reset token for a user and updates the database.

methods.name: POST /auth/reset-password
methods.description: Resets user password using a valid reset token.
